I didn't know anything about welding until I joined in the summer of 2019 to edit videos of Prof. Mendez's heat transfer class and stayed around after. Since then I've been working on a DRA and learning as much as I can from everyone around. It's been great! I like to bake and play piano, and dream of being a (engineering?) physicist.
